context_budget.constraint: must remain comparable with Standard RAG and must not be selected using held-out accuracy
context_budget.truncation_policy: no silent record truncation or record-content rewriting

deterministic_tie_breaking: for semantic fallback only: descending exact float32 score then ascending record_id
hub_policy: Vendor/Employee reverse expansion is restricted; attribute bridges are prohibited.

priority_order.condition: only after the candidate predicate is separately frozen
unresolved gaps only; never creates graph edges
